d: India’s political landscape is witnessing a fresh debate over delimitation as the Narendra Modi government prepares to reintroduce the Delimitation bill in Parliament. After the legislation failed to pass in April 2026, the government reportedly approved a constitutional amendment linking women’s reservation to a 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats across states. A proposed freeze on inter-state representation ratios based on the 1971 Census until 2051 could address concerns raised by southern states.
